title: 测站长读：现行风险与有限观察
paragraphs: The frontier station receives reports from places that have faced different problems. A wet workshop, an overloaded pump and a damaged transfer line may all leave interrupted service, but the interruptions are not interchangeable measurements. Before combining them, the survey team records the place, instrument, working stage and protected service involved. The present visit follows the old city's verified handover. It preserves the direct confirmation that Mara was rescued, while retaining the separately examined responsibilities for design, policy and execution. A new measurement cannot quietly rewrite those earlier findings.
边境测站接收各地不同问题的报告。潮湿工坊、过载泵和损坏线路都可能造成中断，却不能作为同一种测量合并。调查组先记地点、仪表、工作阶段与保护服务。本次继承旧都交接，保留玛拉获救的直接确认及分别核查的设计、政策、执行责任；新测量不能悄悄改写旧结论。

The current forecast distinguishes three approaches to the station. Mist has collected in the low cut, and the open ridge intersects a marked gust channel. The leeward corridor follows visible guide points and contains a sheltered return recess. Its usefulness comes from the agreement between the current forecast and those ground observations. A bright opening elsewhere may look attractive without meeting the same conditions. The team therefore secures the markers, checks the protective kit and deals with the pass hazard before using the paired station entrance. Reading slowly does not make this forecast expire.
现行预报区分三条进路：低切口积雾，裸脊穿过标记阵风通道，背风走廊沿可见向导点并有遮蔽返程凹处。安全判断来自预报和地面观察一致。其他清亮缝隙没有同等条件。先固定标记、检查防护包、处置山口危险，再用配对入口；阅读缓慢不会使预报到期。

Inside the station, the zero and reference marks make the instrument check reproducible. Channel Z should show zero, and channel R should show ten after the local drive is isolated. These numbers belong to this labelled apparatus; they are not a conversion table for load figures reported elsewhere. The operator records the configuration revision with the reading. Reconnecting the drive or changing the configuration removes the current check, even if the saved note still displays the earlier numbers. The retained note remains a historical observation rather than disappearing from the archive.
测站用零点与参考标让检查可重做。隔离本地驱动后，Z通道为零，R通道为十。这些数字只属于该仪表，不转换其他地方的负荷值。读数带配置版本。重接驱动或改配置会撤销当前有效检查，旧笔记仍作为历史观察保留。

A current overload can amplify the network's difficulty in keeping essential circuits stable. This is a useful risk statement, but it has a limited object. The survey does not establish that the towers created every fog bank, nor does it predict the hour of a storm. Conditions beyond the tested local apparatus remain open to further investigation. The notice should name that boundary plainly, so a receiving crew can act on the observed danger without mistaking the notice for a complete explanation of the region's weather or the entire network's history.
当前过载可能放大全网保持基本回路稳定的困难。这是有用但有限的风险判断，不能证明灯塔制造每片雾，也不预测风暴钟点。受检装置以外的条件仍待查。通知应明确边界，让接收班处理观察到的危险，而不会把它当作天气或网络历史的完整解释。

The proposed response protects essential supply while restricting unverified load. Restriction should identify what is preserved, what is delayed and who watches the temporary arrangement. It should not remove the minimum protection of a distant settlement merely because its records are harder to obtain. Nor should a local operator promise unlimited capacity to avoid a difficult discussion. A bounded statement is more useful than a reassuring phrase when the following crew has to check an actual circuit. The present report names a survey stage, rather than introducing a deadline measured by the reader's real-world clock.
应对方案在限制未经核验负荷时保留基本供给，写清保留、延后事项和临时值守。不能因远处聚落资料难取得就撤掉最低保护，也不能为避开讨论承诺无限容量。接班人需检查真实回路，有限说明比安慰话更有用。本报告采用调查工作阶段，不设现实阅读计时。

Return access is part of the investigation, not a reward for its wording. The inner patrol latch is inspected from the station, and both landing stands are checked before the route is registered. The route can remain usable after the current hazard has been controlled. It still does not deliver the later tower cargo or settle its receiving account. A reached return anchor differs from an icon placed on a map: the reached anchor has a present position, a safe stand and an inspection that can be traced back to the actual work.
返程是调查的一部分，不是用词带来的奖励。从测站检查内侧门闩，核两端落点，再登记路线。处置后线路可以继续使用，却不交付后面的塔站货物。到达过的锚点与地图图标不同：前者有真实位置、安全站位和可追溯检查。

When the notice is received, its saved prose and world actions remain separate records. The writer may revise an explanation without changing the instrument, and a configuration change may require a new check without erasing the earlier explanation. Explicit confirmation connects the present meaning to the current draft and source versions. The receiver then verifies the physical work before closing the survey commission. Help with a structured statement makes the intended action clearer; it does not claim that the writer's English has been assessed or that a language examination score has been earned.
正式接收时，正文与世界行动分别保存。修改解释不改变仪表，改配置需要复检但不删除旧解释。明确确认把意思绑定当前正文和源版本，接收人再检查真实工作后闭合调查。结构化辅助让行动意思清楚，不宣称已评定英语或获得考试分数。

title: 准备长读：地方保障与共同容量
paragraphs: The public work list distinguishes conservation of an existing service from enhancement of its future capacity. A tower can be safe to approach while still lacking either kind of completed work. Its base packet contains one isolator, one local backup and two provisions for protected service. Two qualified watch posts and one local installation crew belong to the same conservation arrangement. These are practical requirements with actual owners. They do not become completed work because a diagram contains six tower names, or because the player has acquired enough personal money and spare parts.
公开清单区分现有服务保全与未来容量增强。塔可安全接近，却仍缺完成的工作。基础包含一隔离套、一备用组、两保全包，同一安排还需要两名合格值守和一个安装班组。这些要求都有真实归属，不因图上有六塔名或玩家钱与零件足够就成为完成结果。

Each district retains a facility-conservation contract beside its real tower worksite. The visiting technician matches its current version, the four component serials and the two separate watch posts. R1's isolator cannot be described as R2's local backup, even if both are eventually entered in the shared engineering accounts. The frontier packet has an additional physical journey: inspection at the transfer shed, protection through two escort segments and receipt at the ridge tower. Reading a remote contract list gives a traveller the information needed for a visit; it cannot stand in for that visit.
各地在真实塔站工位保留地方保全合同。技术员核现行版本、四件序号和两个独立岗位。即使最终记入共同工程账，R1隔离套也不能写作R2备用组。边境工包还需中转棚检查、两段护送保护和风脊接收。读远程清单为到访提供信息，不能代替到访。

An accepted order reserves all necessary components and posts together. Transport, delivery, installation and verification then describe different pieces of work. A crew cannot install the same component at two towers at once, and a watch already committed to one tower cannot be counted as another tower's second operator. The local crew has one unit of installation capacity. Cancelling an unused reservation releases its supplies, but cancelling after installation does not manufacture a replacement. Repeatedly opening the work menu advances none of these stages; a declared work action must be carried out and recorded.
承接单把全部组件和岗位一起预留，运输、交付、安装、核验分别对应工作。班组不能同时在两塔装同一件，已承担一塔的人不能再充另一塔第二值守。当地班组同期容量一。未用预留可释放，安装后取消不制造替代件。反复打开菜单不推进阶段，必须执行并登记工作动作。

The enhanced arrangement adds a controller and two couplers to each tower, alongside three transition crates. A reusable test fixture supports its local trial. Published finite contracts describe where these components come from and what acceptance work remains. Retained laboratory apparatus and a sealed investigation sample are evidence, not unclaimed stock for this list. Likewise, the optional two-trip supplement carries its own boxes for its own receiving purpose. Taking a box from that account would break the record of both arrangements, rather than making preparation cheaper through a harmless substitution.
增强每塔另加控制器、两联络组件和三过渡箱，并由可复用夹具支持地方测试。有限合同公开来源与验收步骤。保留的实验装置和封存调查样本是证据，不是待取库存。可选两趟补充也有自己的箱件和接收用途；挪走会破坏两份记录，不是无害省料。

The academy's bounded successful experiment supports a preparation scheme, while its preserved failures describe conditions the scheme must avoid. Together they justify a versioned technical issue; they do not measure six unvisited installations. At each tower the operator checks local isolation, backup, the protected service and the actual return arrangement before observing the present output. A changed installation expires the old trial. The local permit concerns a trial under qualified duty. The later common protocol is a separate agreement, so refusing a final policy today does not prevent a necessary current safety check.
学城受限成功支持准备方案，保留失败说明要避开的条件，二者支持有版本的技术稿，却不是六处未访安装的测量。各塔先核隔离、备用、保护服务和返程，再观察当前输出。改安装使旧测试失效。地方许可针对合格值守下的试验，共同协议另签，不因今天拒选最终政策就阻止安全检查。

For the common protocol, every region needs a current operator and a current representative. Their scopes differ, and their appointment instances must remain distinct. They review protection of essential service, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review under the same published terms. Five organisations appearing in a political summary do not replace six regions' signatures. An old signature remains part of the history after an appointment changes, but it no longer supplies the current mandate. This lets a receiving team see both the previous decision and the actual person now authorised to speak for the role.
共同协议每地需要现任操作方与代表方，范围和任职实例不同。二者按同版条款审阅基本保护、有限联系、互助与独立复核。政治摘要中的五组织不代替六地区签字。任职改变后旧签名保留在历史，却不继续充当前授权，使接收组同时看旧决定和现任职能。

Before departure, the live overview should show what each tower has actually completed and what remains. Six verified base arrangements preserve two eventual directions, while a distributed direction has additional published conditions. A missing enhanced item is a visible piece of unfinished work, not a hidden punishment for declining a private story. The team can continue preparation or explicitly proceed with the base directions. Neither response decides the dangerous central program's final treatment. That later decision belongs to a separate reached control station, after the current promises and moving cargo have been safely handed over.
起航前实时视图应显示各塔已做与未做事项。六份基础结果保留两个方向，分布式另有公开条件。增强缺项是可见未完成工作，不是拒绝个人线的隐藏处罚。可继续准备，也可明确按基础方向出发。二者不决定中央危险程序最终处理；那属于安全交接承诺与货载之后，实际抵达的另一控制站。

title: 关键听力脚本：芬与泰丝的测站简报
paragraphs: Finn: We have the old city's handover, including the direct confirmation of Mara's rescue. Keep that with the earlier responsibility findings. Today's station visit has a narrower job: find out what the present overload is doing to essential service and whether our return route can remain usable. I do not want a report that promises to explain every fog bank. If you use an earlier observation, identify its place and instrument. Similar-looking trouble in two places is a reason to compare the records carefully, rather than a reason to replace one record with the other.
芬：旧都交接已到，包括玛拉获救直接确认，与早前责任核查一起保留。今天任务更窄：查看当前过载对基本服务的影响和返程能否保留，不要承诺解释所有雾。引用旧观察要写地点仪表；两地问题相似是认真比较的理由，不是互换记录的理由。

Tess: The forecast marks three approaches. People sometimes choose the low cut because its beginning looks quiet, but the collected mist is farther along. The open ridge crosses the gust channel. Our marked leeward line has a sheltered recess that we can use on the way back. Follow the current ground markers as well as the sheet. I can explain these features as a local guide; I do not need to join your party for you to receive the route information. Please inspect the protective packet at the distribution stand before leaving.
泰丝：预报有三条进路。低切口开头安静，但深处积雾；裸脊穿阵风通道。标记背风线有返程遮蔽处，要同时看当前地标和纸张。我可作为当地向导解释，不必加入队伍才给路线信息。出发前请在集散站核防护包。

Finn: Secure the guide markers before dealing with the pass obstruction. Once that obstruction is controlled, use the actual paired entrance into the station. A map symbol does not move the team there. The station defence is a separate piece of work, and controlling it will not calibrate the instrument. We have deliberately kept these results apart so the receiving watch can identify a missing step. If a fight goes badly, withdraw to its recorded entry. Your source reading and saved explanation remain available; the retreat is not a reason to award a result that did not occur.
芬：先固定向导标记，再处置山口阻断，随后沿配对入口进测站。地图符号不搬人。测站防卫另算，控制它不校准仪表。分开结果便于接班人查缺步骤。遭遇不利可撤回记录入口，来源阅读和正文保留，撤退不奖励未发生的结果。

Tess: The apparatus uses Z for the zero channel and R for the reference channel. Isolate the local drive, check zero at Z and ten at R, and retain the configuration revision. Those are the apparatus marks, not storm hours and not a shared currency for every district's load figures. If someone reconnects the drive, the earlier check becomes an earlier check. It stays in the archive, but we inspect the present condition again. This is how the next watch distinguishes a retained observation from a current permission to use the instrument.
泰丝：装置Z是零点，R是参考。隔离驱动，核Z零与R十，保留配置版本。这是装置刻度，不是风暴钟点，也不是各地负荷的共同货币。重接后旧检查成为历史，档案还在，但要重检当前情况，让接班人区分旧观察与现行许可。

Finn: A useful notice names the current risk, the supply we must protect and the boundary of the survey. We can say that current overload amplifies the network's difficulty without claiming that every cause is established. We can restrict unverified additional load without removing a settlement's essential protection. Tell the receiving crew which working stage your observations belong to. Do not introduce a countdown while someone reads the report. The world work changes through declared actions and new observations, not through the number of minutes a person spends considering an English paragraph.
芬：有效通知写当前风险、必须保护的供给和调查边界。可说过载放大网络困难，不声称全因果成立；可限制未经核验新增负荷，不撤聚落基本保护。写观察的工作阶段，不在阅读时倒数。世界工作通过行动和新观察变化，不通过思考英语段落的现实分钟变化。

Tess: I will also show you the inner patrol latch. Inspect it from the station and check the two landing stands before registering the return route. That return remains useful after the present hazard is controlled. It is not the same as receiving the ridge cargo later. The four base components will need a manifest, two protected segments and a tower receiving check of their own. I would prefer a report that openly says the cargo has not moved yet to one that combines a safe survey route and an unexecuted delivery in a single cheerful sentence.
泰丝：还会指出内侧巡检闩，从测站检查并核两个落点，再登记返程。处置后返程有用，却不等于后面的风脊货物收货。四份基础件另需货单、两保护段和塔站接收。我宁可报告明确说货物未走，也不把安全调查路和未执行交付合成一句好听话。

Finn: Save your notice at the station desk, then confirm the intended meaning against the current draft. An edit will require that confirmation again. We will receive the actual instrument and return results alongside the notice; the quality of a phrase cannot supply a missing physical check. You may use explicit structured assistance if it helps communicate the action. That records what you mean, without claiming a language score. After the completed survey, the six-tower work and ridge escort can proceed in parallel. The ridge handover does not have to wait for every distant tower to be finished.
芬：在测站桌保存通知，再对当前正文明确意思，编辑后重新确认。接收时同时核真实仪表与返程，用词不能补物理检查。可用明确结构化辅助沟通行动，只记录意思、不声称语言分。调查闭合后六塔工作与风脊护送并行，风脊交接不用等所有远塔完成。

title: 关键听力脚本：六塔工作交接会议
paragraphs: Finn: Let us begin with what the six places need to preserve, rather than with a policy slogan. Every tower has a local contract for an isolator, a backup and two base provisions, with two qualified watches and one installation crew. Their owners and serials are available at the real worksite. A visiting technician must inspect them there. The shared account will then show accepted supplies, but its numbers do not erase their source records. Personal marks, spare parts and the Glimmer's battery belong to different accounts and cannot silently replace these protected components.
芬：先说六地要保全什么，不先喊政策。每塔地方合同含隔离套、备用组、两保全包，两合格值守和一安装班组。归属序号在真实工位，技术员须到场。共同账显示验收供给，却不抹来源。个人刻币零件和船电池另账，不偷偷替保护件。

Local representative: A tower that is safe to approach still needs its conservation work. I want the overview to show that difference. When the crew reserves an order, it holds the whole packet and the posts together. It then carries out transport, delivery, installation and verification as distinct actions. One crew has one current installation capacity. If someone cancels an unused reservation, we can release it. If the component is already installed, a cancellation cannot produce another component. The next crew must be able to find the actual item and the earlier work receipt.
地方代表：可安全接近的塔仍需保全工作，视图要显示区别。预留单把工包岗位一起占住，再分别运输、交付、安装、核验。一班组同期容量一。未用可释放，装好的取消不制造另一件。接班人必须找到实物与旧工作回执。

Technical reviewer: The academy retained unsuccessful runs as well as a bounded successful one. The current preparation issue states the controller, tested load, reserve, isolation and limited contact used in that successful arrangement. It gives us something specific to install and examine. It does not certify six unvisited towers. For an enhanced tower, we still need the actual controller and couplers, transition supply, qualified duty and a current field trial. Replacing an installation makes its old trial historical. Keep the old trial visible, then check the changed arrangement rather than copying its old result.
技术复核岗：学城保留失败和受限成功。准备稿写成功安排的控制器、负荷、备用、隔离和有限联系，给出可安装检查的具体对象，不认证六处未访塔。增强仍需实物、过渡供给、合格值守和当前现场测试。换安装后旧测试成为历史，要保留但重检，不复制结果。

Tess: The ridge packet has only four base components. The first escort starts at the transfer shed after the actual manifest is checked. The outer escort begins through the paired route after its first segment is controlled. At the tower we control the field device, protect the present cargo and deal with the platform, then perform isolation and receipt. Pressure against the platform does not sign the receiving sheet. The optional five-box supplement is a different consignment. If it is declined, those choices must not take the basic packet or an eventual ending direction away.
泰丝：风脊基础只有四件，中转棚核实货单后首段护送，处置首段后沿配对路进入外线。到塔先制护场器、护货、制平台，再隔离和收货。平台压强不签收货表。可选五箱另批，拒绝不能撤基础工包或后续结局方向。

Local operator: Our trial permission concerns this tower's present configuration. I can issue it when the enhanced installation, baseline protection and two local watches are checked. It is not a vote for a final network policy. The common protocol later requires both an operator and a representative in every region. We have different scopes and appointment instances. We will read the same terms on essential protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. An organisation's general position cannot stand in for six current regional signatures, and an old appointment cannot keep signing as the current one.
地方操作岗：试验许可针对本塔当前配置，在增强、基础保护与两值守核实后签发，不是最终政策投票。共同协议每地另需操作方、代表方，范围任职不同，同阅基本保护、有限联系、互助、独立复核。组织立场不代六地签字，旧任职不继续充现任。

Finn: At departure we will list missing work openly. Six actual baseline results preserve the restricted central and orderly disconnection directions. A distributed direction additionally needs the verified technical issue, six enhanced installations, transition supplies, current agreements and trials. A private companion task is not on that list. We can continue the work, use established local commissioned crews, or explicitly accept the two base directions. None of those responses tells us that the dangerous central program has already been stabilised. That remains actual work at the seventh tower after the voyage.
芬：起航时公开缺项。六基础保留受限中央和有序断联，分布式另需技术稿、六增强、过渡、当前协议测试，私人同伴线不在清单。可继续、用已建立地方班组，或明确接受基础方向。任何回应都不说明中央危险程序已稳定，那仍是航后第七塔的实际工作。

Tess: Review the current promises as carefully as the supplies. Cargo still moving needs actual receipt or safe deposit. An accepted promise that requires attendance needs a safe handover or explicit suspension. A previous empty register cannot describe a branch where new work was accepted. Save the handover and preserve the named pre-final checkpoint before sealing preparation. Then reach the chart aboard the same Glimmer and confirm the frontier berth and destination landing. The final departure moves that vessel once; it does not finish the central program or choose the final policy for us.
泰丝：核供给也核现承诺。运输货要真实收货或安全托管，须到场承诺需安全交接或明确暂缓。旧空表不能描述后来接新工作的分支。保存交接、保留命名保护档、封存准备，再到同船海图核边境泊位与目的落点。最终出发只移同一船一次，不完成中央程序或替我们选政策。
